groups.defect: isTeamAdminOrOwner combines isTeamAdmin and isTeamOwner with && instead of ||, so team admins who are not owners are refused.
groups.rationale: All four point at lines 46-48 and report the same wrong operator in the permission check.

groups.defect: Duplicate Attendee rows can be inserted: the server schema and handler never dedupe guests within one request, and the read-then-createMany sequence has a TOCTOU race between concurrent requests.
groups.rationale: s_9e2d0fde and s_c8acf696 report the missing server-side uniqueness check. s_c8acf696 also reports the concurrent TOCTOU duplicate insert, which is the whole of s_6180295c.

groups.defect: The fallback in `message || t("unable_to_add_guests")` can never run because the template-literal message is always non-empty.
groups.rationale: All three report the same unreachable fallback in the onError toast.

groups.defect: findFirstOrThrow with booking.userId || 0 throws an unhandled 500 when a booking has no userId.
groups.rationale: Both point at the same organizer lookup and report the same failure when userId is null.

groups.defect: Guest emails are compared case-sensitively, so case variants get past the BLACKLISTED_GUEST_EMAILS check and the existing-attendee duplicate check.
groups.rationale: s_b8b58cda reports both case-sensitivity problems. The others report one or both of them on the same filter lines, and one normalization fixes all of them.

groups.defect: sendAddGuestsEmails receives the raw guests input instead of uniqueGuests, so existing attendees in the input get the wrong email.
groups.rationale: All four report passing guests instead of uniqueGuests at line 168.
